title: Keep the Claude declaration refusal on manual unselected Resume of a known-unsent User head
outcome: When the first projected row is historical, the UI sends manual queue Resume without a selection. The backend captures the next known-unsent ordinary User prompt but uses a metadata-only declaration check. This can dispatch the same head that a preceding explicit Human Send held after the strict declaration probe failed.
acceptance: After reload with a leading retained historical row and a known-unsent ordinary User prompt, manual unselected Resume keeps the exact runnable prompt paused when the enabled project's declaration is unreadable and gives the reason and remediation.
When access returns, manual unselected Resume starts that same prompt with scoped Engram. Automatic, activation, capacity and receipted/delegation wake behavior remain unchanged.
A regression covers the real unselected UI/HTTP route and verifies the retained historical row remains untouched.
